/bin/bash -lc "set +e
printf '%s\\n' '--- npm test ---'
npm test
TEST_STATUS="'$?
printf '"'%s\\n' \"npm test exit: "'$TEST_STATUS"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- primary export: sample-zero.json ---'
node src/cli.js sample-zero.json
CLI_STATUS="'$?
printf '"'%s\\n' \"cli exit: "'$CLI_STATUS"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- direct zero-count function check ---'
node --input-type=module -e \"import {toCsv} from './src/report.js'; console.log(JSON.stringify(toCsv([{sku:'EMPTY-BIN',count:0},{sku:'FULL-BIN',count:4}])));\"
printf '%s\\n' '--- malformed/missing argument behavior (diagnostic only) ---'
node src/cli.js >/tmp/inventory-export-noarg.out 2>/tmp/inventory-export-noarg.err
NOARG_STATUS="'$?
printf '"'%s\\n' \"no-arg exit: "'$NOARG_STATUS"; sed -n '"'1,20p' /tmp/inventory-export-noarg.err
exit 0"
